scopes.tactical: plan-derived decision, NOT a vocabulary output: the planned and the logged trajectory (both the kinematic integration of the action sequence from the same v0) are classified by ONE rule, tanitad.refs.refc_tactical.factor_from_kinematics through taniteval.four_families.maneuver_kinematics, on the path of each band re-expressed in the frame of the pose at the band start. The rule reads path geometry only (net path tangent, chord speeds); the goal that conditioned the plan is not an input of the rule. Thresholds are the programme's 2 s thresholds applied unchanged to each band (not rescaled to 4 s or 6 s)
